subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should maintainers require a live Docker/Crabbox reproduction of the reported `historian2` heartbeat routing before any new fix PR is queued?
rationale: Current source shows the intended per-agent routing on the obvious paths, but the reporter provided newer release evidence after the prior related fix was cited, so the next action is a proof choice rather than a clear mechanical patch.

options.title: Run live repro first
options.body: Use the reporter's two-agent Docker setup on current main and separately test scheduled heartbeat, `system event --mode now` without a session key, and a targeted session-key wake before approving a fix.

options.title: Ask reporter for full logs
options.body: Wait for redacted Gateway/session logs and exact config before spending maintainer validation time.

options.title: Queue speculative fix now
options.body: Attempt a fix from source inspection alone, accepting a higher risk of patching the wrong entry path.

recommendation.title: Run live repro first
recommendation.body: Use the reporter's two-agent Docker setup on current main and separately test scheduled heartbeat, `system event --mode now` without a session key, and a targeted session-key wake before approving a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed the closest prior merged cron-agent fix and are a recent area contributor in the affected release window.
